title: Full-metadata CatBoost correction over regularized ordinal consensus
hypothesis: A pointwise tree classifier trained on dense metadata and causal cross-session aggregates supplies hard nonlinear partitions that remain complementary to the watch-ratio and same-session-margin DeepFM candidates.

protocol.selection: Tune only the final CatBoost blend weight on one user-parity fold and apply it to the other; repeat in both directions, then fix the deployable weight to the mean of the two selected weights.

recipe: Reconstruct the verified ordered categorical consensus.
acceptance: Both disjoint folds must select a positive, similar CatBoost weight and the fixed mean must beat the previous verified primary.
